An '''adamant spear''' is a [[spear]] of the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tier, made by smithing a [[diamond spear]] with [[adamant alloy]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the diamond item carry over; where both have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It keeps the vanilla netherite spear's stats, {{Hp|5}} damage at an attack speed of 0.87, and has 5000 durability. The adamant weapon intrinsic inflicts Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit. Weakened mobs are what the [[Doom]] intrinsic of adamant armor detonates.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===
Sharpness I, Unbreaking II and Weakness. Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[adamant scrap]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one [[adamant alloy]], returning the alloy but losing the diamonds.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_spear.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* The hand-written tooltip hides the real attributes and shows attack damage 4 (real value 5) and attack speed 0.95 (real value 0.87).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_spear.json}}</ref>
